answer: Delay-chain bond: each identity locks 70 credits for one lotus plot. Each epoch it runs a delay chain from the seed: 60,000 steps no machine can parallelize, each crystal-ticked, sealed with a key-stamp. Auditors replay it; forgery or a reused ferrous stamp burns the bond. One fake costs 115; 1,000 fakes cost 45,000 an epoch and 70,000 locked, over a 40,000 pool. Rented-delay farms pay per chain. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its bond.
